queries.question: What is the average number of glass waste collection points per district in Paris, and how does it relate to the number of mobile phone antennas?

queries.question: What is the average number of women promoted in each category over the years, and how does it compare to the average number of candidates admitted to competitive exams in the same categories?
queries.translated_question: Quel est le nombre moyen de femmes promues dans chaque catégorie au fil des ans, et comment se compare-t-il au nombre moyen de candidats admis aux concours dans les mêmes catégories?
queries.story: This query helps to understand the relationship between women promotions and recruitment statistics in different categories over time, and to identify potential disparities.
queries.code: SELECT Table_0.categorie, AVG(Table_0.femmes_promues) AS avg_promotions, AVG(Table_1.total_des_admis_liste_principale_liste_complementaire) AS avg_admissions FROM Table_0 JOIN Table_1 ON LOWER(CAST(Table_0.annee AS VARCHAR)) = LOWER(CAST(Table_1.annee AS VARCHAR)) AND LOWER(Table_0.categorie) = LOWER(Table_1.categorie) GROUP BY Table_0.categorie

tables.name: Table_1

tables.description: Recruitment data for Paris city officials through competitive exams, including statistics on candidates and positions by category, field, and exam type.

translated_question_keywords: fonctionnaires de la ville de Paris
queries.response: The average number of women promoted in each category over the years is compared to the average number of candidates admitted to competitive exams in the same categories. This comparison can help identify potential disparities in promotions and recruitment. The results can inform strategies to improve equality in the workplace. By analyzing these statistics, organizations can better understand the relationship between promotions and recruitment.

Les résultats peuvent éclairer les stratégies pour améliorer l'égalité sur le lieu de travail. En analysant ces statistiques, les organisations peuvent mieux comprendre la relation entre les promotions et le recrutement.

queries.story: Analyzing the complex relationships between promotions, recruitment statistics, and non-permanent positions to understand the dynamics of the Paris city administration workforce.
queries.code: SELECT Table_0.femmes_promues, Table_1.total_des_admis_liste_principale_liste_complementaire, Table_2.nombre_d_hommes, Table_2.nombre_de_femmes FROM Table_0 JOIN Table_1 ON CAST(Table_0.annee AS VARCHAR) = CAST(Table_1.annee AS VARCHAR) AND LOWER(Table_0.categorie) = LOWER(Table_1.categorie) JOIN Table_2 ON LOWER(Table_1.collectivite) = LOWER(Table_2.collectivite)

queries.response: The relationship between the number of women promoted, the total number of admissions in the recruitment process, and the numbers of men and women in non-permanent positions in the Paris city administration can provide valuable insights into the dynamics of the workforce. By analyzing these metrics, administrators can identify trends and areas for improvement in promoting diversity and equality. The data can also inform strategies for recruiting and retaining top talent in the city administration.

En analysant ces métriques, les administrateurs peuvent identifier les tendances et les domaines d'amélioration pour promouvoir la diversité et l'égalité. Les données peuvent également éclairer les stratégies de recrutement et de rétention des meilleurs talents dans l'administration de la ville.
queries.judge_feedback: The query result is meaningful as it provides insights into the dynamics of the Paris city administration workforce, and the complexity is justified by the need to correlate data from multiple tables.
